labs.title: Geometric solver vs standard-equation side-by-side pipeline
labs.purpose: Build a reproducible Python-capable harness that can feed matched cases to a SAT/H(s)H geometric solver representation and a standard/reference equation implementation, normalize outputs, and compare them without hiding target leakage, fit freedom, unit transforms, or representation changes.
dependencies: Inventory current SAT/H(s)H solver code/interfaces before writing adapters
Select one simple benchmark with a clear reference formulation and a legitimate SAT/H(s)H representation
exposure_constraints: Record target exposure before independent prediction claims
labs.next_cursor: Inspect existing solver/tool surfaces and choose the smallest viable paired benchmark before implementing Python adapters.
labs.exit_criterion: At least one case runs through both sides from a shared case manifest with reproducible environment metadata and an auditable comparison report.
labs.promotion_criterion: Only explicitly characterized equivalence/non-equivalence, validated tooling, or reusable benchmark machinery is promoted; numerical resemblance alone is insufficient.
labs.return_route: WORKSPACES/COMMON/TASK_BRANCH_GRAPH.json or Watercooler depending on outcome

labs.title: The Forest: physical information and worldtube locality
labs.origin: Nathan-direct correction and continuation of The Trees Themselves discussion, 2026-09-21
labs.purpose: Formalize the hard physical-information ancestry principle, define locality relative to SAT/H(s)H worldtube connectivity, and test whether Hagalaz relation geometry plus threefold circle/triswale geometry can provide a rigorous bridge from local B/twist/chirality structure to global toroidal holonomy/closure.
dependencies: Recover or define the actual SAT/H(s)H worldtube-transverse information/interaction channel
Keep Hagalaz relation coordinates distinct from unestablished Hagalaz dynamics
Resolve B genealogy and derive or reject the factor-of-two tangent normalization
Preserve Bell/CHSH and operational no-signalling as explicit benchmarks
exposure_constraints: Lab status only; no automatic theory authority
Do not treat exact algebraic identities as physical derivations without the missing geometric/dynamical bridge
Keep uud/udd and particle-count mappings explicitly provisional
Follow project symbol-management and citation-as-default controls
labs.next_cursor: Define the native worldtube adjacency/channel and identify which Hagalaz state variable or transport law carries a physical difference; in parallel derive or kill the factor-of-two in B=1/(2 Delta_3) and solve the signed triswale response A_3(s).
labs.exit_criterion: Produce an explicit, source-controlled model in which the physical information path, Hagalaz transport, threefold B geometry, signed chirality variable, and toroidal closure law are either mathematically connected by derived maps or cleanly separated/rejected, with Bell/CHSH behavior addressed.
labs.promotion_criterion: Promote only individually derived/verified bridges; conceptual coherence or numerical resemblance alone is insufficient.

labs.title: Coil-let / bosonic-wave structural candidate
labs.origin: Nathan Direct / 2026-09-30 image-description and structural synthesis pass
labs.purpose: Formalize and stress-test the candidate mapping from persistent first-order worldtube coils and traveling higher-order coil packets to closure, particle/wave registration, transparency, photon/neutrino differentiation, three-sphere generation, ᚼ indexing/scale relations and selected BH::BB/vacuum branches.
dependencies: Define a coordinate- and display-independent closure invariant
Define a geometry-to-observation/probability map rather than treating visual closure as quantum collapse
Recover photon/neutrino spin-statistics and interaction-sector distinctions
Derive compatible dispersion and propagation speeds
Define chirality state and transition operator
Separate calibration values from held-out predictions for three-sphere/ᚼ scale tests
exposure_constraints: Top-contender structural candidate is not BEDROCK authority
Conceptual images are not metrological evidence
Pseudo-fit or numerical resemblance does not establish particle-wave duality
Preserve PRIOR_ART quarantine and source boundaries
Factory Floor promotion remains a separate staging decision
labs.next_cursor: Define the smallest explicit closure invariant and two-path observation map; independently derive three-sphere/ᚼ coil-index candidates and identify one held-out photon/neutrino or chirality observable capable of falsifying the mapping.
labs.exit_criterion: Either obtain a small explicit geometric model that maps carrier/coil/closure/chirality states to independently checkable observables, or identify the first unavoidable inconsistency and record the branch as killed/restricted.
labs.promotion_criterion: Promote only separately derived and tested relations; the ontology does not graduate as a package.

labs.title: Three-sphere coiling response and inertial-limit test
labs.origin: Nathan Direct / 2026-10-05 delayed-send three-sphere and coiling-response hypothesis cluster
labs.purpose: Test whether a three-sphere extension of the UI/TX scale-rotation scaffold can generate worldtube coiling through a constrained relation and whether slack/over-/under-tension, impediment and release yield recoil, deflection, coil defects, parity/helical-plane flips, plus a straight coarse-grained force-free limit.
dependencies: Recover the historical UI/TX controls and 4DHH/particle-Lagrangian ancestry without importing superseded ontology
Define a testable scale-rotation/coiling relation instead of manual curve drawing
Define constitutive tension/slack state and perturbation variables
Choose a coarse-graining/centroid map for testing rectilinear emergence
Use the SAT rigor backstop: benchmark, purge, candidate extraction, minimal extension, observable-limit check
exposure_constraints: Fresh hypotheses are to be pursued and tested, not reported as established
Do not infer particle creation, quantum foam, baryogenesis or f-boson production before the lower-level geometry forces those consequences
UI/TX is a tool/solver; a sphere visualization is not automatically ontology
Preserve alternative vacuum-medium branches and PRIOR_ART quarantine
labs.next_cursor: Run the force-free helix centroid test and the smallest scale-rotation constitutive model; then perturb its preferred state to see whether recoil/defect/parity-flip modes actually occur.
labs.exit_criterion: Produce a reproducible geometry/mechanics model that either derives a nontrivial scale-rotation/coiling relation and its linear response or shows where the three-sphere mechanism fails or remains underdetermined.
labs.promotion_criterion: Promote only relations that cross the recovered SAT rigor backstop; do not promote the hypothesis cluster as a package.
